szoveg_eredeti:
We tasked teams of Gemini 4 agents with improving quantum circuits for modelling fusion energy, chemistry, and enzymes relevant to drug design.

Working in parallel and meeting every four hours to debate ideas, they used the formal theorem prover Lean to verify that optimizations were mathematically sound - and found improvements that cut future simulation costs by up to 10 times.

We’re open-sourcing the verified solutions and our Lean library on GitHub. Find out more →  https://goo.gle/4zCtQOK
